Title: [JOURNEY] Punchout — ERP setup to a signed-in buyer adding to the organization's default cart
Preconditions:
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
The mapped buyer {{USER_EMAIL}} belongs to exactly one organization and that organization has an existing default cart (its id is read by REST/GraphQL in the first step). Punchout.Enabled is on for the store.
Desktop viewport 1920x1080.
Steps:
--- SCREEN: ERP setup ---
[AUTH] password grant for {{buyer}}; [HTTP] query the organization's default cart id; [CAPTURE] it → DEFAULT_CART_ID; discard the token
[SETUP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/punchout/cxml (Content-Type text/xml) with a cXML 1.2.041 PunchOutSetupRequest: Sender Credential domain={{domain0}}, Identity={{ident}}, SharedSecret={{secret0}}, BrowserFormPost URL={{retUrl}}; [CAPTURE] the StartPage URL → START_URL
[ASSERT] the response carries cXML Status 200 and a StartPage URL ending in /punchout/<43-character token>
--- SCREEN: start page landing (fresh context) ---
[NAV] {{START_URL}}
[WAIT] the storefront leaves /punchout/ and loads the signed-in home page
[ASSERT] the account menu in the top header shows the buyer, not 'Sign in'
[ASSERT] the label 'Punchout mode' is in the desktop top header next to the account menu
[ASSERT] the current organization shown in the header
--- SCREEN: catalog ---
[NAV] {{frontUrl}}/search?q={{sku}}
[WAIT] product list loaded
[ACT] click 'Add to cart' on the product with SKU {{sku}}
[WAIT] the cart notification appears
--- SCREEN: cart ---
[NAV] {{frontUrl}}/cart
[WAIT] cart page loaded
[ASSERT] cart line for SKU {{sku}} with quantity 1
[HTTP] read the cart that holds the line through the storefront GraphQL endpoint using the page's own session; [CAPTURE] its id → PUNCHOUT_CART_ID
[HTTP] read me.contact.organizations and the current organization id
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[API] errors[] is empty in every GraphQL mutation this flow issues
[CONSOLE] no TypeError or JS error on any page in the flow
[NETWORK] no 4xx/5xx on /graphql
Failure_Signals: redirect to /403 or the home page signed out, label missing, organization empty, a new cart id, console error on /punchout/, 4xx/5xx on /connect/token
Cleanup: remove the line for SKU {{sku}} from the cart; sign out through the account menu popup

Title: Punchout storefront — with Punchout Enabled off the /punchout/ route does not exist on a fresh context
Preconditions:
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
Changes the store-wide setting Punchout.Enabled of the configuration-0 store — the store the other punchout suites sign in on — so it runs alone (exclusiveGroup store-setting:Punchout.Enabled). Write it through the Admin SPA store Settings > Punchout (Save), never PUT /api/stores with a partial body; wait for the public setting to read back before opening the storefront, and use a fresh browser context for every read.
Steps:
[NAV] {{frontUrl}}/punchout/agent-test-not-a-token in a fresh context (setting ON — control)
[WAIT] the page settles
[ASSERT] URL and page heading
[SETUP] turn 'Punchout Enabled' off on the store {{store0}} (store Settings > Punchout, Save) and read the setting back
[NAV] {{frontUrl}}/punchout/agent-test-not-a-token in a second fresh context (setting OFF)
[WAIT] the page settles
[ASSERT] URL and page heading
[NAV] {{frontUrl}}/agent-test-unknown-path in the same fresh context (setting OFF)
[WAIT] the page settles
[ASSERT] URL and page heading
[SETUP] turn 'Punchout Enabled' back on and read the setting back
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[CONSOLE] no TypeError or JS error on the page under test
[NETWORK] no 4xx/5xx on /graphql
Failure_Signals: /403 with the setting off, a not-found page with the setting on, the setting not restored, console error
Cleanup: set 'Punchout Enabled' on the store {{store0}} back to its value before the case and read it back

Title: Punchout storefront — the 'Punchout mode' label is translated in every theme locale and never shows a raw key
Preconditions:
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
Punchout.Enabled is on. The mapped buyer {{USER_EMAIL}} is signed in through a fresh start link; the language switcher lists every theme locale.
Steps:
[SETUP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/punchout/cxml (Content-Type text/xml) with a cXML 1.2.041 PunchOutSetupRequest: Sender Credential domain={{domain0}}, Identity={{ident}}, SharedSecret={{secret0}}, BrowserFormPost URL={{retUrl}}; [CAPTURE] the StartPage URL → START_URL
[NAV] {{START_URL}}
[WAIT] signed-in home page loaded
[ACT] click the language switcher in the top header
[WAIT] the language list is visible
[READ] the list of languages shown; [CAPTURE] it → LOCALES
[ACT] for each language in LOCALES, select it in the language switcher
[WAIT] the page reloads in that language
[READ] the text of the label in the desktop top header; [CAPTURE] the texts → LABELS_BY_LOCALE
